7→Sun, default Unknown.
cards.reference:
func weekdayName(d int) string {
    switch d {
    case 1:
        return "Mon"
    case 2:
        return "Tue"
    case 3:
        return "Wed"
    case 4:
        return "Thu"
    case 5:
        return "Fri"
    case 6:
        return "Sat"
    case 7:
        return "Sun"
    default:
        return "Unknown"
    }
}
